description: Create an interactive study course on a topic or from the user's sources (notes, URLs, PDFs, YouTube, images, audio). Use when the user wants to study a topic, prepare for a test, exam or interview, understand a concept, or make a study guide. The course includes structured units with quizzes and flashcards. Pass course_id to open an existing course instead.

ai_chat_context.description: Short summary of the points from this chat the user wants covered, not a transcript (merged into Notes)

ai_research.description: AI-generated research content based on the topic (will be merged into Notes)

course_id.description: Optional course ID to retrieve an existing course. If provided, retrieves the course instead of generating a new one.

document_urls.description: Document URLs (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, CSV, HTML, RTF)

is_public.description: Whether course should be publicly accessible

level.description: Difficulty level: beginner, intermediate, or advanced

notes.description: Text notes to include in course content

tags.description: Optional key-value pairs for course categorization

topic.description: Course topic or name (required if course_id not provided)

webpage_url.description: Single webpage URL to extract content from

name: study_concept
title: Study Concept
